name: Hawaii

filing.name: Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs, Business Registration Division

labor.name: Hawaii Department of Labor and Industrial Relations

entityTax: Corporate income tax and General Excise Tax

permitFee.note: One-time General Excise Tax license registration fee; a branch license has no additional charge.

penalty.note: 5% of the unpaid tax for each month or part of a month the return is late, up to 25%; a separate 20% penalty can apply if tax on a timely return stays unpaid 60 days.

unemployment.note: $30 for a quarterly wage report that is skipped, late or incomplete (Haw. Admin. Rules 12-5-17); the maximum contribution rate may also apply.

newHire.note: $25 late filing penalty, or $500 if the failure results from a conspiracy (per the Child Support Enforcement Agency FAQ).

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: $100 for each employee for every day without coverage, with a $500 minimum.

paidLeave.title: Temporary Disability Insurance (TDI) coverage
paidLeave.description: Employers must provide TDI coverage for employees; employees may be charged up to half the premium.

local.title: County permits
local.description: Hawaii has no general local business license; counties issue zoning, building and industry permits.

cannabis.regulator: Hawaii Department of Health, Office of Medical Cannabis Control and Regulation
cannabis.note: Adult-use sales are not authorised; possession is decriminalized.
